en.headline: Cathay Group orders 14 more Airbus aircraft for fleet expansion
en.dek: The order covers 11 A330-900s and three A321neos, bringing planned new deliveries from 2026 to 120 and total investment commitments above HK$150 billion.
body: The Cathay Group said on Wednesday it has placed a firm order for 14 additional Airbus aircraft, comprising 11 A330-900 wide-body jets and three A321neo narrow-bodies.

The additional A330-900s build on a 2024 order for 30 of the type, taking the firm commitment to 41. The three A321neos add to a previous order for 32 A320neo-family aircraft placed in 2023. The planes will support regional and longer-haul operations for Cathay Pacific and growth at HK Express.

Group chief executive Ronald Lam said the new orders bring total aircraft deliveries from 2026 to 120, closer to a plan of 150 new aircraft and a network serving 150 destinations over the next decade if market conditions allow. The commitments take the group’s total investment for the decade to 2035 above HK$150 billion.
The A330-900 is powered by Rolls-Royce Trent 7000 engines and offers improved fuel efficiency. Deliveries of the additional aircraft are expected in the early 2030s.

zh.headline: 國泰集團再訂購14架空中巴士飛機擴充機隊
zh.dek: 新訂單包括11架A330-900及3架A321neo，使2026年起新飛機交付總數達120架，十年投資承諾超過1500億元。
body: 國泰集團周三表示，已向空中巴士落實再訂購14架飛機，包括11架A330-900寬體客機及3架A321neo窄體客機。
新增的A330-900是在2024年30架訂單之上，使該機型確定承諾達41架。3架A321neo則加在2023年32架A320neo系列訂單之上。新飛機將支援國泰航空的區域及較長途航線，並支持香港快運擴展。
集團行政總裁林紹波表示，新訂單使2026年起的飛機交付總數達120架，更接近未來十年150架新飛機及150個目的地的計劃（視市況而定）。相關承諾使集團至2035年的總投資超過1500億港元。
A330-900採用羅爾斯·羅伊斯Trent 7000發動機，燃油效率較高。額外飛機預計於2030年初交付。
